project.description:
Compare two database backups table-by-table using gradle compareLoads.
Loads BEFORE_PATH, snapshots every table (row count + content hash), loads AFTER_PATH, snapshots again, then emits a per-table before/after comparison CSV (archived as a build artifact).
Set LIST_ONLY to true to list available backups without loading.
Note: This drops and recreates the database TWICE. All existing data will be replaced, and the AFTER backup is left loaded when the job finishes.

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: BEFORE_PATH
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: Full path to the "before" backup file. Run with LIST_ONLY=true first to see available paths.

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: AFTER_PATH
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: Full path to the "after" backup file. Run with LIST_ONLY=true first to see available paths.

hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.name: LIST_ONLY
hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.description: List available backups and exit without loading.

hudson.model.TextParameterDefinition.name: NOTES
hudson.model.TextParameterDefinition.description: Optional notes for the build history (e.g. what change the two loads bracket, ticket number).

hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
#!/bin/bash set -e
echo "==============================" echo "Compare-Database-Loads" echo "=============================="
if [ -n "$NOTES" ]; then echo "" echo "Notes: $NOTES" echo "" fi
# List available backups (also shown when either path is blank). if [ "$LIST_ONLY" = "true" ] || [ -z "$BEFORE_PATH" ] || [ -z "$AFTER_PATH" ]; then echo "" echo "Available backups in $DB_UNLOADS_PATH:" echo "---------------------------------------" for dir in $(ls -dt "$DB_UNLOADS_PATH"/20??.??.??.* 2>/dev/null); do bak=$(ls "$dir"/*.bak 2>/dev/null | head -1) if [ -n "$bak" ]; then size=$(du -sh "$bak" | cut -f1) date=$(stat -c '%y' "$bak" 2>/dev/null || stat -f '%Sm' "$bak" 2>/dev/null) echo " $bak ($size, $date)" fi done echo ""
if [ "$LIST_ONLY" = "true" ]; then echo "LIST_ONLY=true, exiting without loading." exit 0 fi fi
if [ -z "$BEFORE_PATH" ] || [ -z "$AFTER_PATH" ]; then echo "ERROR: both BEFORE_PATH and AFTER_PATH are required (see the listing above)." exit 1 fi
for f in "$BEFORE_PATH" "$AFTER_PATH"; do if [ ! -f "$f" ]; then echo "ERROR: Backup file not found: $f" exit 1 fi done
echo "" echo "BEFORE: $BEFORE_PATH" echo "AFTER: $AFTER_PATH" echo "" echo "Starting comparison (this drops and recreates the database twice)..." echo ""
cd $SOURCEROOT gradle compareLoads -Dbefore="$BEFORE_PATH" -Dafter="$AFTER_PATH"
echo "" echo "Comparison complete. Summary: build/db-load-comparison/table_load_comparison.csv"
